entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.comment:
Animals for fattening include domestic animals, normally intended for reproduction and breeding within livestock activities and aquaculture activities, including rabbits and bees.
0511 91 90: only inedible fish eggs
Except: 0301 11 00, 0301 19 00, eggs for hatching ornamental birds
